headline: Sensex gains 333 points as oil prices cool and metals shine
why: Cooling global oil prices providing relief to the domestic economy
Strong performance in metal and FMCG sectors ahead of Fed call
Positive global cues from Nikkei and other Asian markets
whatHappening: Shapoorji Pallonji Group supports Tata Sons listing, impacting Tata stocks
Rupee strengthens to 95.73 against the US dollar in early trade
Bank of Japan hikes interest rates as AI and chip stocks rally
Gold prices hit record levels of Rs 1.52 lakh per 10 grams

stocksInNews.sources: Shapoorji Pallonji Group backs Tata Sons listing causing group stocks to fall
IT sector drags and Tata Group stocks face selling pressure
Metal stocks shine in the market recovery
FMCG sector shows strength ahead of Federal Reserve decision

summary: The Indian market ended its two-day losing streak as the Sensex rose 333 points, driven by cooling oil prices and gains in metals. However, Tata Group stocks faced a sell-off following news regarding the potential Tata Sons listing.
